phase_conventions.phase: native MeCN free energies vs matched native Fc; gas Nelsen is separate diagnostic
phase_conventions.capacity_nominal_mAh_g: Declared electrons and exact active-species mass; no counterion/backbone correction.
phase_conventions.accessible_capacity_mAh_g: Native potential window and integrity-contiguous path bookkeeping, withheld where a scoped model limitation applies; kinetics assessed separately.
phase_conventions.model_accessible_capacity_estimate_mAh_g: Original model window/path estimate retained for diagnosis; not qualified capacity when model_primary_admissible is false.
phase_conventions.model_max_observed_error_V: Largest reviewed free-parent residual for the scoped model limitation; never a measurement or error bound for an exact graft.
phase_conventions.gas_Nelsen_sum_eV: Only QC-clean current-protocol four-point GAS diagnostic; never a validated solution rate or full solution reorganization energy.
phase_conventions.empty_numeric_cells: Pending, flagged or not independently admissible. Never substituted parent/zero values.
phase_conventions.experimental_accuracy: No exact graft has an experimentally validated property in this dataset.
phase_conventions.paired_shifts: Candidate minus declared exact-graft control, same charge/electron ladder and snapshot. Each event requires two admitted values; no surface/parent substitution or improvement claim.
phase_conventions.spin_qc: UMA gaps<0.5eV require DFT alternatives; DFT electronic gaps within0.2eV require matching native spin thermals; native gaps within0.1eV require spin-ensemble evaluation. Raw surfaces remain diagnostics; far positive electronic gaps retain explicit thermal uncertainty.
phase_conventions.native_g_thermal_eV: Corrected native partition of the selected single spin surface, before any equilibrium mixing correction.
phase_conventions.effective_g_thermal_eV: Native term added to the selected active SMD energy; includes an admitted equilibrium spin correction when selected.
phase_conventions.spin_ensemble_correction_eV: Equilibrium G minus selected-surface G. Component spin degeneracy is included once, not multiplied again.
phase_conventions.spin_ensemble_alternative_population: Alternative-spin equilibrium population at 298.15 K under the selected two-spin model; this does not validate kinetics.
phase_conventions.workbook: Immutable snapshot of independently audited external pipeline records, no spreadsheet formulas.
